analysis.headline: Altman says RAM belongs in data centers, not personal PCs
analysis.summary: Tom's Hardware and The Verge report OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in a podcast interview that it is 'terrible' for people to keep RAM in their own PCs rather than AI data centers. The Verge adds Altman made the remark on the Cheeky Pint podcast when asked about supply chain shortages, including the ongoing RAM shortage.
